No skip entry is recorded for them: skip entries in vacuity-check mean the SCAN abstained, and a `.skip` test is scanned.
#1312: only `.only`/`.skip` were added (as the issue names); `xit`/`fit`/`it.each`/`test.concurrent`/`it.todo` remain unrecognised.

#1312: a JS declaration on a comment line (`//` earlier on the line, or a line opening `/*` or `*`) is not a test. Line-based, like the existing `isComment`; a declaration inside a block comment whose line has no leading `*` is still read as code.

#1312: vacuity-scanner.ts untouched (#1365 serialization). Its `jsDeclarationStart` still looks only for `it(`/`test(` with a quote, so for a backtick or `.only`/`.skip` declaration with its title wrapped to the next line, the coverage-pragma walk starts at the title line; and VAC rules do not consult `skipped` (one VAC-001 now reports an `expect(1).toBe(1)` inside a `.skip` fixture test). Filed as a follow-up.

#1449: the fixture is anchored on `resolveServedRoot(process.env, process.cwd())` evaluated at test-module load, i.e. the same inputs the server read for its WORKING_DIR at import.
